text:
Kai: Quick Q  landing in SF at 6:30pm, staying near Market St. Want good casual Mexican for 3 people. Not a huge wait pls.
Sofia: Taqueria El Buen Sabor on 5th is small but fast and solid tacos.
Devon: For sit-down w/ decent margaritas try La Catrina on Mission, reservations recommended.
Priya: If you want late, there's a taco truck outside the Civic Center M-F that runs until 11.
Kai: Any place with veggie/vegan taco options?
Sofia: Veg-friendly: Gracias Madre (plant-based) a bit of a Lyft away but great.
Devon: Also try Elote Cocina for roasted corn plates and veggie-friendly sides.
Kai: Perfect. Also heads-up: flying to Madrid next week  any tapas recs near Sol?
Priya: Taberna El Sur is cozy and reasonably priced. Mercado de San Miguel is touristy but good for variety.
Sofia: For late-night churros, try San Gine9s near Sol  open late.
Kai: Awesome, thanks. Back to SF  who's up for group lunch Fri 12:30? @Sofia @Devon
Devon: :white_check_mark: I'm in.
Sofia: Might be heads down but will try to join.
lunch-bot: Poll created: "Group lunch Fri 12:30?" React with :white_check_mark: for yes. Event added to calendar if majority RSVP.
Kai: I'll book La Catrina if enough people. Will DM details.
Priya: If you need to split orders, I can bring the card.
Kai: Thanks team  will share reservation and tapas recs for Madrid after I go.
